title: A website that survives a server dying
about: A shop's website on one computer is closed the moment that computer breaks. Here the same site runs on two computers, with a front door that sends each visitor to one that works. Watch what happens when one of them stops: visitors do not notice.
tryThis: Stop ha1-back-a, then refresh the site on port 8001. It still works. Start it again and both servers share the visitors once more.

roles.ha1-front: The front door. Every visitor arrives here and is sent to a server that works.
roles.ha1-back-a: One of two identical web servers that build the page.
roles.ha1-back-b: The second identical web server. It takes over when the first one is gone.
